name: MS_Azure Possible Brute Force - Bad Username Password by IP
xql_query:
// ============================================================
// Rule: MS_Azure Possible Brute Force - Bad Username Password by IP
// Vendor: Microsoft EntraID
// Objective:
// Detect activity associated with MS_Azure Possible Brute Force - Bad Username Password by IP.
// Severity: SEV_030_MEDIUM
// Category: CREDENTIAL_ACCESS
// ============================================================
// MITRE ATT&CK:
// Tactic: TA0006 - Credential Access
// Technique: T1110.001 - Brute Force: Password Guessing
// Technique: T1110.002 - Brute Force: Password Cracking
// Technique: T1110.004 - Brute Force: Credential Stuffing

config case_sensitive = false
| dataset = msft_azure_raw
| filter resultType in ("16003", "50034", "50053", "50056", "50126", "90125", "120000")
| alter bin_time = _time
| bin bin_time span = 1m
| alter id = properties -> id,
        createdDateTime = properties -> createdDateTime,
        userDisplayName = properties -> userDisplayName,
        userPrincipalName = properties -> userPrincipalName,
        userId = properties -> userId,
        appId = properties -> appId,
        appDisplayName = properties -> appDisplayName,
        ipAddress = properties -> ipAddress,
        errorCode = properties -> status.errorCode,
        failureReason = properties -> status.failureReason,
        deviceId = properties -> deviceDetail.deviceId,
        location = properties -> location,
        city = properties -> location.city,
        state = properties -> location.state,
        countryOrRegion = properties -> location.countryOrRegion,
        geoCoordinates = properties -> location.geoCoordinates,
        latitude = properties -> location.latitude,
        longitude = properties -> location.longitude,
        originalRequestId = properties -> originalRequestId,
        isInteractive = properties -> isInteractive,
        tokenIssuerName = properties -> tokenIssuerName,
        tokenIssuerType = properties -> tokenIssuerType
| comp earliest(_time) as Earliest_EventTime,
       latest(_time) as Latest_EventTime,
       count(resultType) as ResultType_Count,
       values(properties) as Properties_List by bin_time,
       callerIpAddress,
       resultType,
       resultDescription,
       userDisplayName,
       userId,
       userPrincipalName,
       errorCode
| filter ResultType_Count >= 10 and timestamp_diff(Latest_EventTime, Earliest_EventTime, "MINUTE") <= 10
| filter (resultDescription not in (null, """"""))
description: Falhas de autenticação múltiplas (10 ou mais) para o mesmo usuário em um intervalo de 1 minuto. Pode indicar uma tentativa de força bruta ou atividade suspeita.
